warnings: Every beam here (B1-B5, B1', B3') is 0.15m wide x 0.40m deep with stirrup RB6mm@0.20m — no variation. Beams B2/B3/B4/B5 print two cross-sections (SECTION 1-1 near the support, SECTION 2-2 near midspan, standard practice: top steel is heavier near supports, bottom steel heavier at midspan). Per §7 precedent (B2/B4/B5/B3 curtailment case already documented in the schema), the max count at each face is recorded in main_bar with a note describing the curtailment between the two printed sections, rather than treating SECTION 1-1 and SECTION 2-2 as two different specs.

B4 and B5 each print an extra 2-bar group of a different diameter (2-DB16) that moves face-to-face between SECTION 1-1 (top, at support) and SECTION 2-2 (bottom, at midspan) — recorded as additional_bars rather than folded into main_bar.top/bottom, since the drawing shows it as a distinct leader/count from the base 2 or 3-DB12 group in both sections, unlike the true continuous-vs-curtailed single-diameter bars on B2/B3.
